disagreements.slovak: Voda vo fľaši je veľmi studená.
disagreements.answer: Water in the bottle is very cold.

disagreements.slovak: Keby ryby mali ruky, ony by tlieskali tomu nahodeniu. Naozaj legendárna technika.
disagreements.answer: Were fish to have hands, they would applaud that throw. Truly legendary technique.

disagreements.answer: While they were sightseeing in the small blue town, a donkey was blocking the alley. Slightly unplanned stop.

disagreements.slovak: Kto dal ten gól? Dievča v zelenom.
disagreements.answer: Who scored? The girl in green.

disagreements.slovak: Ona môže trénovať golf celú noc! Muž je úplne v šoku!
disagreements.answer: She can train golf all night! The man is completely in shock!
